svg.title: What gets deployed
svg.desc: Single-region Azure resource layout with App Service, two identities, enforced NSP Key Vault, and separate management and customer capacities assigned to Fabric workspaces.

g.text: One Azure resource group. Fabric and Entra service objects live outside ARM resource-group scope.
Azure resource group - West US 3 by default
Never assigned to a customer tenant
Multiple tenant workspaces may share compute
Created or selected explicitly during onboarding
Not purchased by initial application deployment
Exclusive workspace mapping per application tenant
Reports + semantic models; one principal per tenant
New content stays unpublished until reviewed
No VNet, private endpoint, separate worker, distributed cache, or deployed queue.
Entra objects: sign-in app, tenant embedding principals, and optional embedding group. Not ARM resources.
Dashed arrows = compute assignment, NOT network access or authorization. B1 / active Fabric compute are billable.
Initial release is single-instance. HA, durable workers, production rotation and unattended CI/CD remain future work.
